name: keycutter-cli
description: Command-line interface for the context-aware credential architecture, generating and verifying structured tokens.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/Cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/Cli.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cp ../LICENSE ../README.md ./ && npm publish

author: leoweyr <contact@leoweyr.com>
